assay_run.assay_type: ELISA of secreted IL-6, IL-8 and CCL2
assay_run.method: Aggregate Figure 3C comparison across three hydrogel stiffness groups. Culture supernatants were assayed using BioLegend IL-6, IL-8 and CCL2 ELISA kits; cytokine measurements were normalized to total protein measured by BCA. Plate-reader model and individual acquisition/aliquot identities are not reported.

sample.biological_model: Three-dimensional gingival fibroblast culture in collagen–alginate ECM hydrogel
sample.biological_source: Primary human gingival fibroblasts isolated from healthy donor gingiva
sample.sample_material: Culture supernatant collected after 24 h stimulation with 1 µM Pam3CSK4 following four days of hydrogel culture (nominal storage modulus G′ ≈ 0.75 kPa). Figure 3C reports n = 4; individual donor/preparation identities and aliquot crosswalks are not supplied. Collagen is a matrix reagent, not the human cell source.
